summary: Master GIS mapping and spatial analysis for electric power transmission and distribution. Enroll in our expert-led training course and boost your career!
lede: GIS mapping helps power distribution utilities visualize network assets and use location data in planning and operations. The course is for utility engineers, GIS analysts, planners, and asset teams responsible for electric infrastructure. Participants practice mapping lines, feeders, transformers, and substations; analyzing routes and rights-of-way with spatial overlays; and integrating GIS with SCADA, ERP, and CMMS data to support asset maintenance and outage analysis.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals responsible for managing, analyzing, or planning electric power infrastructure, including:
audience: GIS analysts and technicians in utilities
Renewable energy developers and grid integrators
Infrastructure project managers and spatial data coordinators
modules: Introduction to GIS for Electric Power Systems
Integrating Remote Sensing and Satellite Data
GIS for Asset and Maintenance Management
Data Visualization and Spatial Decision Support
